meta.what: EAVS stages from residents to ballots counted, by state and county, with each figure's EAVS item code

sources.what: residents and citizen voting-age population: effective.json (2010 and 2020 Census; ACS CVAP 2014-2018 and 2019-2023)

items.label: Removed: failed to respond to a notice and did not vote
Ballots cast (derived: counted + mail rejected + provisional rejected; a floor)

meta.rows: each row is a value per id in ids; null is missing (never zero). State rows: v the sum of jurisdictions with a figure, miss the jurisdictions without, missReg the registered voters in them, pr the pairwise-valid rate parts [removed, registered, mail rejected, mail returned, provisional rejected, provisional cast, counted, registered].

notes.towns: New England states report by town. A town's 10-digit FIPS code starts with its county's five digits, and towns are summed by those five digits. Connecticut's codes are the eight historic counties the page uses.
notes.stateOnly: Alaska reports as one unit and Wisconsin by municipality with no county code, so both are state rows only.
notes.counties: A county's figure is null when any jurisdiction in it has no figure for that item.
notes.guards: A removed registration or a rejected ballot is not a count of eligible voters turned away; the page shows the reasons as the jurisdictions reported them.
notes.cast: EAVS has no total-cast item; ballots cast is counted + mail rejected + provisional rejected (a floor)
notes.removalWindow: removals are counted from the close of registration for the previous November general election to the close of registration for this one
notes.dup: 2024 adds A12h removed duplicate records and A12a includes it; earlier waves have no such item

turnout.tolerance: people counted (F1a) over the page's votes must be within -1% to +5% (a ballot can skip a race); presidential years compare the presidential votes, 2018 and 2022 the largest Senate or governor total the page has in the state (a floor, so only the lower bound is a test)
